A complete, single-file HTML website for an artisan neighborhood bakery.
The website will be visually distinctive, warm, inviting, and rustic yet modern.
All CSS and JavaScript will be inline within the single index.html file.

**Structure:**
- **Header:** Bakery name ("The Daily Crumb"), navigation links (Home, Menu, About, Contact).
- **Hero Section:** Full-width background image of baked goods, a welcoming headline ("Freshly Baked, Daily Made"), and a call-to-action button ("View Our Menu").
- **Menu Section:** A grid display of various baked goods (e.g., Sourdough, Croissants, Pastries, Cakes) with images, short descriptions, and prices.
- **About Section:** A brief story about the bakery's philosophy and history.
- **Contact Section:** Address, operating hours, phone number, and a simple contact form (placeholder).
- **Footer:** Copyright information and social media links (placeholder icons).

**Styling (CSS inline):**
- **Color Palette:** Warm and earthy tones (e.g., #8B4513 (saddlebrown), #F5DEB3 (wheat), #D2B48C (tan), #A0522D (sienna), #FFFFFF (white), #333333 (dark gray for text)).
- **Typography:**
    - Headings: A decorative, elegant script font (e.g., "Great Vibes" from Google Fonts).
    - Body text: A clean, readable sans-serif font (e.g., "Open Sans" from Google Fonts).
- **Layout:** Responsive design using flexbox and media queries for mobile-friendliness.
- **Visual Elements:** Subtle shadows, rounded corners, hover effects on buttons and menu items. High-quality placeholder images for baked goods.
- **Backgrounds:** Soft textures or subtle patterns.

**Interactivity (JavaScript inline):**
- **Smooth Scrolling:** For navigation links.
- **Simple Form Validation:** (Client-side placeholder for the contact form).
- **Dynamic Menu (Optional, for simplicity, will stick to static for now):** If time permits, a simple modal or detail view for menu items. For this benchmark, a static menu is sufficient.

**Libraries:**
- Google Fonts for "Great Vibes" and "Open Sans".
- Font Awesome for social media icons (via CDN).

- **Header:** Bakery name (e.g., "The Daily Crumb"), navigation links (Home, Menu, About, Contact).

- **Footer:** Copyright information, social media links (placeholder icons).

- **Color Palette:** Warm, earthy tones (e.g., soft browns, creams, muted greens, a touch of deep red or gold).
- **Typography:** A mix of elegant script/serif for headings and a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.
- **Layout:** Responsive design for mobile and desktop. Use Flexbox or Grid for layout.
- **Imagery:** High-quality, appetizing images of baked goods.

**Interactive Elements (JavaScript):**
- A simple smooth scroll for navigation links.
- A basic form validation for the contact form (ensure fields are not empty).

The entire site should be contained within a single `index.html` file, with `<style>` and `<script>` tags embedded directly.</description>

Our Story & Philosophy

Welcome to The Daily Crumb, a neighborhood bakery born from a passion for traditional baking and a love for our community. We believe that the best bread and pastries are made with simple, high-quality ingredients, time-honored techniques, and a generous sprinkle of heart.

Every morning, our ovens come alive, filling the air with the irresistible aroma of freshly baked goods. From our slow-fermented sourdoughs to our delicate, flaky pastries, each item is crafted by hand with meticulous care. We source local ingredients whenever possible, supporting our fellow artisans and ensuring the freshest flavors.

The Daily Crumb is more than just a bakery; it's a gathering place, a source of comfort, and a celebration of the simple joys of life. We invite you to taste the difference that passion and dedication make, and become a part of our baking family.
